core_pain: ICP (01-icp, executed on supplied data only — no invented personas). Woman 24-45 (some men), US/ZA/PH/CA, Facebook mobile, 2am scroller. The live pain: she met someone (ex, current partner, or someone new) and the familiarity was instant and disproportionate — she "knew" them before knowing anything about them, the intensity made no sense, and the fear of losing them showed up on day one. The humiliating part she tells no one: she has felt this exact pattern before with someone else, it ended the same way, and she is afraid she is the one repeating it. What keeps her awake: "Why does this feel like unfinished business? Is this real or am I doing it again?" Conscious desire: understand the connection. Unconscious desire: permission to stop calling herself "too intense" and to be told the pull has a name. False beliefs: "if it feels like fate it must be" / "if it hurts this much it must mean something" / "I can't trust my own read anymore." Enemies: friends who say "you barely know him," dating apps that treat it as chemistry, generic "twin flame" content that promises reunions. What she has tried: free horoscope apps, TikTok tarot, texting the person, journaling — none gave her a frame for the repeating pattern. Product fit: a symbolic frame (archetype) that names the pattern and the lesson, not a verdict about the other person.
buying_agenda: (buying-agendas.md / gerador-de-hooks.md NOT found in the Ignite directory; agenda derived from ICP + 06-hook-writer angles.) She will buy when the funnel delivers, before the paywall, a named archetype that makes her feel recognized rather than diagnosed, and when the "reaction" lines prove the guide understood her answers. Three purchase motives in order: (1) relief — the pattern has a name and a lesson, so she is not broken; (2) curiosity loop — what the archetype "may represent today" with this specific person (ex/current/new) stays partially open; (3) permission — a 7-day guarantee and a $9.99 anchor make the $39.99/$59.99 choice feel like buying ongoing reflection, not a bet on a prediction. What kills the purchase: any hint of predicting the other person, any promise of reunion, any "past life as fact" wording, countdowns or fake scarcity. Offer must read as "the full reading of this connection + unlimited readings + Spiritual Guide 24/7", with "Draw My Soulmate" mentioned only as a later, optional portrait on the thank-you page.

validation_verdict: ADVANCE WITH ADJUSTMENTS (03-validador). Strengths: dor is urgent (the person exists now — ex, current or new), audience already spends on this category, mechanism is deliverable today with the existing engine (enumerated answers + cards + preview), and the big idea passes the 2am test. Adjustments required: (1) every archetype/era line must carry symbolic hedging ("this archetype often speaks to...", "as a symbol") — never a historical claim; (2) the "who is this person" branch must not produce any statement about the other person's feelings or future; (3) the birth-season question must feed atmosphere/texture only, never a "fact" about her past life; (4) differentiate from the existing /quiz/ex funnel: F3 is about the PATTERN she carries, not about him — keep the ex option but do not re-angle the whole funnel around it; (5) no new proof beyond "120,000+ readings delivered" and 4.9. Failure modes: Meta disapproval for fortune-telling claims, audience cannibalization with the ex funnel, preview giving too little real value (then the paywall feels like a bait).
